newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar eases on greenback's overseas rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar eases on greenback's overseas rise.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar slipped against its American counterpart in early Tuesday trade as U.S. dollar buying emerged in the wake of the greenback's strong overnight showing against the yen and the mark overseas, dealers said.
After 45 minutes, or 0145 GMT, the local unit was at T$27.879 against Monday's T$27.862 close. Early turnover through dealers was a light US$8 million.
Dealers described the local currency's softness as limited.
"The firming U.S. dollar in overseas markets boosted some buying interest, but the Taiwan dollar doesn't have much room to fall in the near term," said a dealer at a foreign bank.

Dealers said the Taiwan dollar remained in a slowly depreciating trend, but would not immediately test eight-year support at T$28 due to strong expectations that the central bank intervention would intervene if it did.
A range of T$27.86-89 was seen for Tuesday.
